headline: Batch 1 is in preparation. Deposits are not open yet — the waitlist hears first.

stages.title: Groundwork
stages.note: KMJ Dynamics LLC formed (Massachusetts, Aug 2026). Production design finalized off the prototype. Frame welding partnered with a professional fabrication shop.

stages.title: The paperwork you'd want us to have
stages.note: Product liability insurance and attorney-drafted terms of sale, warranty, and deposit terms are in progress now. Deposits open when this is done — not before.

stages.title: Deposits open
stages.note: $500 fully-refundable deposit reserves a numbered build slot. Waitlist members get first access, in signup order.

stages.title: Materials ordered
stages.note: Metal, motors, wheels, electronics — ordered for the full batch. The long-lead items are the custom motor order and the frames.

stages.title: Frames welded
stages.note: All ten frames welded from 6061 aluminum by the fab shop, to the prototype's measured dimensions.

stages.title: Drivetrain, steering, electronics
stages.note: Built by John, cart by cart, in slot order — same hands that built the prototype.

stages.title: Testing and QC
stages.note: Every cart gets a serial number and a recorded test and QC checklist before it leaves — including full remote-loss failsafe testing.

stages.title: Delivery
stages.note: Hand-delivered by John, Maine to New Jersey, in build-slot order.

slots.label: Cart #1 — shop prototype, not for sale. Built first, on camera, starting Aug 23.

footnote: This page is updated when something real happens, and only then. If a stage is waiting on something, it says so.
